title: Leads: Call Done is judged by what was said on the call, and Undo has no timer
text: The automatic move from Call Scheduled to Call Done no longer depends on how long the recording is. It reads the recording's transcript: two voices must each have said real words, and one of them must not be the team or the notetaker. A recording with no real conversation leaves the booked call open, so the lead still asks "Did this call happen?". The automatic move itself is still switched off.
points: Undo this move has no time limit: it works while the lead is still where the system put it and nothing else has happened to it.
Each automatic move now shows a "Moved because..." line on the lead.
A call a person already answered is never overruled by a later copy of the recording.
